profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon Music
profile.summary: Strong knowledge of Object-oriented programming, understanding of algorithms, and experience in Android, ASP.NET MVC, and AWS (Amazon Web Services). Known as a self-starter, team player, growth mindset, relentlessly resourceful, and multitasker. Ability to derive creative and innovative solution

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: Laravel MVC, Elasticsearch, Kibana, HTML, JavaScript, MySQL, PHP 

Primary developer responsible for creating and maintaining back-end and front-end of accounting and property management web app using Elasticsearch and Laravel MVC on Linux 

Build Elasticsearch structures for syncing and managing data from MySQL Database 

Create task scheduling running on Linux using Laravel, and export data to PDF, CSV through Elasticsearch and Database

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Technologies: ASP.NET MVC, C#, LINQ, Razor, HTML, JavaScript, MS SQL, PHP, Laravel

Create, and maintain website by ASP.NET MVC 

Import, export data from and to PDF, Excel, CSV, and Image files through database.

Manage MS SQL Database using MS SQL Server Management Studio.

Hashing password and creating verification for user login. 

Create transaction pages for credit card using API.

positions.title: PhoneGap Project Team Member
positions.description:
Technologies: PhoneGap, Angular, AWS

Convert an existed pre-booking website for jail to application on android phone/tablet with team included eight people for ATIMS company

Connecting to server API and Database in ATIMS company.

Working on AWS (Amazon Web Services), and deploying new code to make existed website to work on phone and tablet.

Using PhoneGap to convert website application on Android phone and tablet

Create barcode scanner on Angular.
